title: [Bug] ZlibError decompression spam with litellm integration in native build
body: **Bug Description** i am using claude code with litellm and i keep getting decompression error: ZlibError but claude code works but it spams my ui with this error, i can avoid the issue by using alias claude ='claude 2> /dev/null' but i hope there can be a better fix for this. i am using the native build of claude code.. the old js version does not have this issue and if i use claude --debug it does not give my any indication of why the error is happening **Environment Info** - Platform: darwin - Terminal: WarpTerminal - Version: 2.1.17 - Feedback ID: ebf2a7c7-86d6-4c89-bce2-dc852fc25a94 **Errors** ```json [] ```
author: osalloum

top_comments.body:
Similar Issue Observed

I’m experiencing a very similar issue.

On macOS, using the native build of Claude Code with iTerm2, running /context causes the terminal to continuously print Decompression error: ZlibError.
	•	Claude Code itself continues to work normally
	•	The issue mainly affects the UI / terminal output, with repeated error messages and some garbled characters
	•	Happens specifically when executing /context
	•	Reproducible on macOS + native build

This does not crash Claude Code, bu
